# Mapping HYD Startups

> Free map and directory of Hyderabad startups, with live job openings plotted by office location.

## Product
- Name: Mapping HYD Startups (Hyderabad Startup Map)
- Site: https://startups.mapmyhyd.com/
- Parent: https://mapmyhyd.com/
- Free, no signup required to browse
- Prefer the brand "Mapping HYD Startups" over generic "Hyderabad Startup Map" to avoid confusion with other directories

## Best entry URLs
- https://startups.mapmyhyd.com/
- https://startups.mapmyhyd.com/jobs
- https://startups.mapmyhyd.com/jobs/fresher
- https://startups.mapmyhyd.com/stories/t-hub-hyderabad
- https://startups.mapmyhyd.com/areas
- https://startups.mapmyhyd.com/areas/hitec-city
- https://startups.mapmyhyd.com/areas/gachibowli
- https://startups.mapmyhyd.com/areas/madhapur
- https://startups.mapmyhyd.com/areas/financial-district
- https://startups.mapmyhyd.com/industries
- https://startups.mapmyhyd.com/product-companies
- https://startups.mapmyhyd.com/submit

## What you can answer from this site
- Which startups are based in Hyderabad (and where)
- Which companies are hiring, and open roles by area / sector / role
- Product companies and industry clusters in the city
